program: Oppstartstilskudd 1 (Innovasjon Norge; the former etablerertilskudd/markedsavklaring stage)
stopper_list: 1. The company must be established as an AS before the application is sent; ENK, ANS, DA are not approved (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)

2. Company younger than five years; the guide article says under three years, exceptionally five (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1 ; https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/artikkel/slik-hjelper-vi-deg-som-starter-bedrift)

3. Only purchased services from external suppliers are covered; own time and internal costs are not, so the 90,000 NOK of own time must come out (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
4. Costs from related parties (naerstaaende) are not covered (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
5. Costs incurred before the application is sent are not covered (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
6. VAT is not covered (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
7. Covers up to 100% of invoiced costs, maximum 150,000 NOK (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
8. At least 50% of project costs must be pre-financed; up to 50% is paid at start and the rest at project end (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
9. All costs must be documented, or the grant can be reduced (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)

10. Idea-phase work must be done before applying: problem understanding from customer dialogue, 3-5 findings, today's alternatives, hypotheses and a test plan; otherwise it is probably too early to apply (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1 ; https://cdn.sanity.io/files/loal7n8w/inno-prod/2c2bd6df96695dc6c9899b5b9f5782e94bb6dc99.pdf)
11. Hobby-based or part-time activity is normally not prioritised (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)

12. Livelihood businesses (levebrodsforetak) are not prioritised; the company must be a real new establishment with growth ambition, also internationally (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)

13. The solution must be substantially new: standalone apps without clear innovation, simple easily copied solutions, and a simple implementation or assembly of existing solutions are normally not supported (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
14. The grant is for market learning and testing hypotheses with customers, not for developing a finished solution (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
15. Businesses with ongoing payment remarks cannot apply or receive the grant (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
16. No support for taking over an existing business, which matters for an ENK-to-AS move (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
17. Ownership: subsidiaries 50% or more owned by an established business do not qualify; at 25-50% the business must be clearly separate (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
18. Other public support, including SkatteFUNN, must be declared in the application (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
19. Project period is 9 months, extendable by up to 3 (max 12) (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1)
20. Nettbank access and payout requests need a role in Bronnoysundregistrene: daglig leder, styreleder, styremedlem or prokura/signaturrett (https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/seksjon/kundesenter)

A: 'Egenfinansieringen maa dokumenteres for hele prosjektperioden' (turn 1): no official page states this; the call page only requires pre-financing of at least 50% and enough liquidity
'Ingen paagaaende betalingsanmerkninger, verken for deg eller selskapet' (turn 1): the page covers only businesses; A corrected this itself in turn 2
